name: Domainee
description:
Domainee is the custom domains API for SaaS. Your users connect their own domain to your product with one API call - Domainee issues the SSL, renews it forever, and watches the DNS so you don't have to.

Connect your workspace and Claude manages the whole domain lifecycle from a conversation:

- Connect a customer hostname for proxy or redirect through the Domainee edge
- Check verification status and force an immediate DNS/SSL re-probe
- List, update, and remove domains; inspect DNS records and monitor state
- Verify a customer's CNAME is in place before flipping them live
- Manage webhook endpoints for domain lifecycle events

Plus 16 domain and DNS diagnostic tools that work on ANY public domain:

- SSL certificate check, WHOIS lookup, domain age, domain availability
- DNS record, CNAME, and TXT lookups; DNS propagation checker
- SPF, DKIM, and DMARC record checkers for email deliverability
- HTTP header checker, redirect tracer, website status, subdomain finder, reverse IP lookup

Built for SaaS teams that offer white-label or custom domains, and for anyone who debugs DNS. Ask "why isn't my customer's domain verifying?" and let Claude check the CNAME, the propagation, and the SSL chain in one go.

Requires a free Domainee account. Domain management uses your workspace; diagnostic tools work on any domain.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Domainee to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Domainee to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.domainee.dev/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Domainee MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Domainee lists 27 MCP tools, including check_domain, create_domain, create_webhook_endpoint, delete_domain, delete_webhook_endpoint, dns_check_records_exist, dns_check_records_match_exactly, get_domain, list_domains, list_webhook_endpoints, tools_cname_lookup, and tools_dkim_record_checker.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Domainee?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Domainee in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Domainee requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Domainee is developed by Domainee. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
